text:
Ollie Park: quick one from today's office hours — a few attendees hit an odd workflow when using json_mode + function_call: they wanted to inspect the raw payload when validation failed but the SDK threw and gave no handy raw string.
Mira Desai: yes saw that too. the current pattern is either swallow (bad) or throw (confusing). we should offer a tidy helper that returns both parsed and raw on demand.
Julian Price: proposal: add `responses.parseOrRaw(payload, schema, opts)` helper in SDKs. behavior: try strict parse -> on failure return { parsed: null, raw: '<stream>', diagnostics: { error, offset } } unless opts.throwOnError = true.
Ollie Park: love it. for bootcamp we can show two patterns: quick prototyping (schema_coerce + parseOrRaw) and production (strict + telemetry + idempotency).
Mira Desai: tiny example to add to sample README:
```js
// quick debug helper for labs
const result = await client.responses.parseOrRaw(streamedText, ticketSchema, { coerce: true });
if (!result.parsed) {
  console.log('parse failed, raw payload:', result.raw);
  // show troubleshooting tips
}
```
Julian Price: also add a `on_parse_error` callback option to `client.responses.create` so handlers can decide whether to retry, fallback, or persist raw frames. That reduces boilerplate in sample apps.
Ollie Park: shipping checklist: (1) SDK: parseOrRaw + on_parse_error hook + docs, (2) Bootcamp: replace crashy example with debug pattern and short slide on "inspect raw frames", (3) tests: unit + e2e that simulates trailing commas, number<->string mismatches, and auth-retry mid-stream.
Mira Desai: I'll file a ticket and add a short playground harness in the bootcamp repo that trainers can run to reproduce common parse issues locally.
Devex Bot: New issue created: DEVEX-1705 - "parseOrRaw helper + on_parse_error hook + bootcamp playground" https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/DEVEX-1705 :white_check_mark:
Julian Price: small UX note: don't enable coercion by default; use it as an explicit opt-in for labs. ensure changelog calls out parity between JS/Py behavior.
Ollie Park: agreed. PR plan: Mira will draft SDK PR, Julian will add tests, I'll update the bootcamp README and slide text. ETA: EOD Friday for initial PRs.
Mira Desai: adding a short FAQ blurb: "If your schema parse fails, use parseOrRaw to inspect raw output and consider schema_coerce for prototyping. Never silently coerce in production."
Julian Price: nice. that should cut down on the "my bot crashed during demo" threads. :thumbsup:
